name: wedding_payment_schedule
description: Works out the amount and due date of each of the three wedding payments for one total cost.
formula: payment 1 = first_payment_amount, due today + first_payment_days_from_today days; remaining = total_cost - first_payment_amount; payment 2 = remaining x second_payment_share, rounded to 2 decimals (halves round up), due wedding_date - second_payment_days_before_wedding days; payment 3 = remaining - payment 2 (so the three payments add up exactly to total_cost), due wedding_date - third_payment_days_before_wedding days.

inputs.name: total_cost
inputs.description: Total wedding cost for this case, in your currency. Use the result of the total cost step. It must be at least the first payment amount.

inputs.name: first_payment_amount
inputs.description: The fixed first payment, in your currency. It counts toward the total cost.

inputs.name: first_payment_days_from_today
inputs.description: Whole number of days from today until the first payment is due.

inputs.name: second_payment_days_before_wedding
inputs.description: Whole number of days before the wedding when the second payment is due.

inputs.name: third_payment_days_before_wedding
inputs.description: Whole number of days before the wedding when the third payment is due.

inputs.name: second_payment_share
inputs.description: Share of the remaining cost paid as the second payment, as a fraction: 0.5 means 50%. The third payment gets the rest.

output.description: Flat object with six keys: payment_1_amount, payment_1_due_date, payment_2_amount, payment_2_due_date, payment_3_amount, payment_3_due_date. Amounts are money in your currency; dates are calendar dates.
